footer.$description: Tokens of `footer`, the information at the bottom of a page.

border-color.$description: Color of the line above the footer.

border-width.$description: Width of the line above the footer.

max-inline-size.$description: The largest inline size of its content.

padding-inline.$description: Space at the sides of its content.

padding-block.$description: Space above and below its content.

gap.$description: Space between the logo, the content and the links.
